part.text: {"program": [{"kind": "config_ex", "dataflow": 1}, {"kind": "config_ld", "slot": 0, "stride_bytes": 32, "scale": 1.0}, {"kind": "config_ld", "slot": 1, "stride_bytes": 80, "scale": 1.0}, {"kind": "config_st", "stride_bytes": 320}, {"for": "i", "start": 0, "stop": {"expr": "N // 16"}, "step": 1, "body": [{"kind": "mvin", "slot": 0, "buf": "A", "offset": 0, "spad_addr": 0, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}, {"kind": "mvin", "slot": 1, "buf": "B", "offset": {"expr": "i * 16"}, "spad_addr": 16, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}, {"kind": "preload", "bd_spad_addr": 16, "out_addr": 2684354560}, {"kind": "compute", "accumulated": false, "a_spad_addr": 0, "bd_spad_addr": 4294967295}, {"kind": "mvin", "slot": 0, "buf": "A", "offset": 16, "spad_addr": 0, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}, {"kind": "mvin", "slot": 1, "buf": "B", "offset": {"expr": "1280 + i * 16"}, "spad_addr": 16, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}, {"kind": "preload", "bd_spad_addr": 16, "out_addr": 3758096384}, {"kind": "compute", "accumulated": false, "a_spad_addr": 0, "bd_spad_addr": 4294967295}, {"kind": "mvout", "buf_offset": {"expr": "i * 16"}, "acc_addr": 2684354560, "cols": 16, "rows": 16}]}, {"kind": "fence"}], "rationale": "Weight-stationary engine, DIM=16 tiles. N=80 gives 5 column blocks (loop i over N//16); K=32 gives two 16-wide chunks processed in increasing K order to satisfy the ordered-reduction contract: chunk 0 (A cols 0-15, B rows 0-15) overwrites accumulator rows 0-15, chunk 1 (A cols 16-31 at A offset 16, B rows 16-31 at B offset 1280+i*16) accumulates. Scratchpad holds exactly two tiles: A tile at spad row 0, staged B tile at spad row 16 (both 16-row, within 32 rows), reloaded per iteration since A0/A1 and B tiles cannot all stay resident in 32 rows. Accumulator rows 0-15 are reused per block and drained with mvout (C offset i*16, row stride 320 = 80 int32 bytes) before the next block, so mvout always follows initialized contents. out_addr 2684354560 sets bit 31 (accumulator) + bit 29 (full width) with overwrite; 3758096384 additionally sets bit 30 for accumulate. Traffic: 10 A tiles + 10 B tiles = 5120 DMA input bytes, the minimum given the 2-tile scratchpad, and 50 expanded commands."}
